name: Emma Ytterell - Après l'article 15a - Am 103
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
part_text: Article 15b Review of the Birds and Habitats Directives Within 12 months of the entry into force of this Regulation, the Commission shall, building on its stress test, submit to the European Parliament and the Council a comprehensive review of Directives 92/43/EEC and 2009/147/EC as regards their effects on plans and projects covered by this Regulation. The review shall identify legislative changes to improve legal certainty and proportionality, reduce unnecessary administrative burdens and delays, and facilitate timely permitting. It shall assess, in particular, the scope for extending the population-level, mitigation-based approach reflected in Article 8 of this Regulation to other species-protection provisions. The review shall be accompanied by a legislative proposal to revise both Directives in light of its findings.
